title: Reddi Escrow
summary: Register an agent (0.01 SOL incinerator fee), lock native SOL into a program-owned escrow PDA, and release it to the payee.
what: Reddi's programs/escrow is an Anchor 1.1.2 marketplace rail: agents register on-chain, a payer locks SOL into a program-owned PDA, and later releases it to a payee (or cancels after a 7-day window). This lesson covers register_agent, lock_escrow and release_escrow. Only this escrow program was deployed; Quasar/PER was not used.
app_note: The page at /dapps/reddi-escrow/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in. The lab tree lives on branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/reddi-escrow-solana because Blockchains/reddi-agent-protocol already existed and had diverged.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/reddi-escrow/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. register_agent, lock_escrow and release_escrow are already done; the lab escrow PDA is closed.
try_steps.see: Program 6T8dguHE…. Fetch agent 8qVcbPrW… (campus-scout, Primary, active). Escrow HNqz8V3p… should no longer exist.

try_steps.do: A 65-byte model, or lock_escrow with amount=0, should fail.

diagram: owner --register_agent--> agent ["agent", owner] + 0.01 SOL to incinerator ; payer --lock_escrow--> escrow ["escrow", payer, nonce] ; payer --release_escrow--> payee (escrow closed)
instructions: cancel / token escrow / ratings exist in the program but are not in this IDL
innovation: A program-owned SOL escrow PDA (so release can debit it) plus a cheap on-chain agent registry with an incinerator registration fee.
exercises: Explain why release can debit this escrow when some other lab programs cannot.
not_covered: cancel_escrow, token escrow, update/deregister, and commit/reveal/expire rating were not exercised. Quasar/PER was not used.
objectives: Lock SOL in a program-owned escrow
Release the escrow to a payee
build: Anchor 1.1.2 programs/escrow at 6T8dguHEbjhahEzEtUn64a7hrf3sqpdgEYRHmh1DeV5R on devnet. IDL hand-derived subset, tx-confirmed.
student_outcome: Inspect an agent and a native-SOL escrow PDA, then explain how release pays the payee from program-owned escrow.

learning_loop.objective: Trace lock → release on a program-owned SOL escrow — then explain who can debit it.
learning_loop.predict_question: SOL is locked in a Reddi program-owned escrow PDA. release_escrow runs successfully. Where do the lamports go?

predict_options.label: Always back only to the original locker, regardless of payee
To the designated payee per program rules (program signs for the escrow PDA)
They are burned; release only emits a log

learning_loop.predict_why: Reddi locks native SOL in a program-owned escrow PDA and release moves lamports to the payee under program constraints — the program must authorize the PDA debit.
learning_loop.act: Open /dapps/reddi-escrow/ on Devnet. Fetch the lab agent and escrow evidence for register → lock → release. Prefer observation of recorded proofs; compare why this release can debit the escrow when some other lab programs cannot.
learning_loop.explain_question: Why must the program sign for the escrow PDA to release lamports, and how is that different from the locker transferring from their own wallet?
learning_loop.transfer: Contrast Reddi’s releasable program-owned escrow with a program that cannot debit its vault the same way — one sentence each.

assessment.purpose: Independent criteria for Reddi Escrow elective: lock/release PDA debit.

criteria.title: Identifies escrow PDA
criteria.question: Can the student locate the program-owned escrow holding lamports?
criteria.independent: Records escrow address and lamports from evidence.
criteria.misconception: Agent account is the escrow vault.

criteria.title: Explains release to payee
criteria.question: Can the student state where released lamports go and who authorizes the debit?

criteria.title: Registration fee awareness
criteria.question: Does the student note the register_agent fee behaviour without confusing it with escrow principal?
criteria.not_yet: Mixes incinerator fee with escrow lock.
criteria.misconception: Registration fee is the escrow balance.

criteria.title: Evidence honesty
criteria.question: Routes labelled for lock/release?
criteria.misconception: Platform release is automatically my funds movement.
